main_text.p: uxorem. Cum autem ad imperium jam evectus Othman varias quae apud homines essent, lectiones videret, exemplaria ex illo qui penes Hapbsam erat, libro transcripta in varias passim regiones mittens reliqua omnia e medio sustulit.

Ismael Abul Feda] cui nomen cum agnominibus & Epithetis quibus insigniri solet اسمعيل بن علي الملک المويد عماد الدين ابو الفدا صاحب حماة Ismael Ebn Ali &c. Almaleo'l Moaiyad Amado'ddin AbulPhedai Saheb Hamah, seu Dominus Hamah cui provinciae praefectus est, anno Hej. 710. natus est anno 672. Historiam suam vocat المختصر في اخبار البشر Geographiam تقويم البلدان.

Allannabius ] ابو محمد مصطفى بن السيد حسن [ الحسيني الهاشمي القرشي Abu Mohammed Mostafa EbnolSaiyed Hasan AlHosaini AlHashemi AlKoraishi, vulgo الجنابي Allannabii titulo notus, eoque ab Ahmede Iosephi filio laudatus. Se Mohammedis sepulchrum visisse ait anno H. 963. Historiam suam perduxit ad annum H. 997.
Amed Ebn Yusef, seu Iosephi filius] احمد بن يوسف Finem historiae suae imposuit mense Moharram, an. H. 1008.

p. 39.Scholiastes in Epistolam [leg. in Poema] Ebn Abduni] Poematis author ابو محمد عبد المجيد ابن عبدون Abu Mohammed AbdolMajid Ebn Abdun, Commentariis illud illustravit عبد الملک ابن عبد الله الحضرمي السبتي Abdol Malec Ebn Abdillahi AlHa-drami

page.notes: Arabic lines are transcribed as printed, right to left, but the scan is small and some diacritics and word forms are uncertain; the Arabic readings, especially the names in the Allannabius and Ibn Abdun entries, should be checked against the original. "Hapbsam" is printed as such (the long s is rendered as s). The marginal "p. 39." stands beside the Scholiastes entry. The Google watermark at the lower right is excluded.
